course.title: Dynamics and Kinematics of Machineries
course.department: Department of Energy Science and Engineering

content.value: . Two automobiles A and B are traveling in the same direction in adjacent highway lanes. Automobile B is stopped when it is passed by A, which travels at a constant speed of 15 mi/h. Two seconds later, automobile B starts and accelerates at a constant rate of 0.90 m/s². Determine – (i) when and where B will overtake A; (ii) the speed of B at that time.
